summary: Lura is an API gateway designed to handle high-performance routing and aggregation of backend services. It acts as a reverse proxy that sits between clients and microservices to manage traffic flow.
goodFor: It suits development teams building microservice architectures who need a lightweight routing layer to aggregate multiple backend calls into a single client response.
watchOut: Maintenance activity is currently slowing down, which might affect response times for security patches or new feature requests over the long term.
deployNotes: As a Go binary, it typically runs as a standalone executable without needing a separate database, though you will need to handle TLS termination and configuration management externally.
